### Walking in Sustainable Faith
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/walking-in-sustainable-faith-bible-study-minute-november-12-2018.html
Passage: John 6:66
Points:
- Many walked away from Jesus because His teaching exceeded human comprehension.
- Faith is designed to carry believers through what their finite minds cannot grasp.
- True discipleship requires taking intentional daily steps in close alignment with Christ.
- When life brings pain and testing, believers must lean into Jesus rather than turn back.

### Deserter Or Disciple?
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/classic/deserter-or-disciple-classic/
Passage: John 6:66
Points:
- Failing to act on God's revealed truth leads to bondage under alien viewpoints.
- Debating divine truth fosters self-interest and insistence on personal rights.
- Resting on past spiritual experiences cannot substitute for active, present obedience.
- Every fresh unveiling of truth forces a choice: move forward as a disciple or leave as a deserter.
